vulnerability.name: Remote File Inclusion
vulnerability.description: Vulnerabilities allowing inclusion of remote files that can lead to code execution
vulnerability.impact: Remote code execution, complete system compromise, or malicious script injection
vulnerability.mitigation: Disable remote file inclusion, validate all file sources, use allowlists for trusted domains

findings.title: Vulnerable Code
findings.vulnerable_code: function CashOut(uint _am) public payable { if(_am<=balances[msg.sender]) { // <yes> <report> REENTRANCY if(msg.sender.call.value(_am)()) { \ balances[msg.sender]-=_am; \ TransferLog.AddMessage(msg.sender,_am,"CashOut"); } }}
findings.explanation: The call() function is used to execute a remote script without proper validation, making it vulnerable to Remote File Inclusion.
findings.impact: Remote code execution and complete system compromise.
exploitation_steps: Send a malicious value for _am to trigger the remote script execution.
The script will execute and attempt to withdraw funds from the contract.
findings.exploitation_conditions: msg.sender is authenticated and balances[msg.sender] >= MinDeposit
findings.remediation: Validate the _am value before executing the call() function.

chunk_analyses.notes: This contract is vulnerable to Remote File Inclusion due to the use of call().

findings.title: Vulnerability found
findings.explanation: The 'require(msg.sender.call.value(_weiToWithdraw)())' line includes a remote script call without proper validation.
findings.impact: Malicious script execution could lead to full system compromise.
exploitation_steps: User authenticates and calls withdrawFunds with a large amount
Exploiter sends a small amount to trigger the call
Exploiter includes a malicious script in the call
findings.exploitation_conditions: msg.sender is authenticated and has sufficient balance
findings.remediation: Use a safer function like require(bytes memory(_data), _data.length) to validate and sanitize user input.

findings.title: Remote File Inclusion
findings.explanation: Delegates to a remote URL without proper validation, allowing Remote File Inclusion vulnerabilities.
findings.impact: Code execution and potential system compromise.
findings.exploitation_conditions: User provides malicious input for delegatecall function
findings.remediation: Properly validate and sanitize input data before delegating to a remote URL.

findings.title: Remote File Inclusion
findings.explanation: The execute function allows remote file inclusion through the use of sha3(msg.data, block.number), which can be manipulated to reference a malicious file.
findings.impact: Remote code execution and potential compromise of the entire system.
findings.entry_point: /execute(address _to, uint _value, bytes _data) external onlyowner returns (bytes32 o_hash)
exploitation_steps: Manipulate msg.data to reference a malicious file.
findings.remediation: Validate and sanitize user input to prevent sha3(msg.data, block.number) from referencing malicious files.

chunk_analyses.notes: This vulnerability is due to the lack of input validation in the execute function.

findings.title: Vulnerability found
findings.explanation: Insecure use of `require()` function with unvalidated user input (`url`). This allows remote file inclusion.
findings.impact: Potential code execution and compromise of the system.
exploitation_steps: Send a malicious URL as the `file` parameter to `include.php` or `index.php`.
